name: PayPal
description: Pull PayPal transaction history into the wealth + tax domains via the PayPal REST Transaction Search API (OAuth2 client-credentials).
connection: PayPal REST Transaction Search. Create a REST app at developer.paypal.com, enable the Transaction Search feature, and provide its Client ID + Secret. Glyph Engine mints an OAuth2 client-credentials token and pulls your transactions read-only.

connections.description: PayPal REST Transaction Search via OAuth2 client-credentials. Set PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID, PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET (+ PAYPAL_ENV=sandbox|live).
